provenance.source: Foiles, Baskes & Daw, Phys. Rev. B 33, 7983 (1986): the 'universal 3' (u3) EAM functions for Cu; experimental values from Kittel, Introduction to Solid State Physics (8th ed.), Table 1.3 / 3.1
provenance.licence: numbers only (facts), cited; no potential file is redistributed here
provenance.note: The EAM functions were fitted to the experimental lattice constant and cohesive energy, so the u3 potential reproduces them by construction; the values below are the fitting targets. Our own LAMMPS numbers on the Cu_u3.eam file are stored in data/records/eam_cu_lattice.json with the route and version that produced them.

a0_fit.meaning: fcc lattice constant, fitting target of the u3 Cu potential (equals the experimental value)

ecoh_fit.meaning: cohesive energy, fitting target of the u3 Cu potential (Foiles-Baskes-Daw 1986, Table I)

a0_expt.meaning: experimental fcc lattice constant of Cu at room temperature (Kittel)
